677:t_008:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's a rare thing. I'm of the same opinion as you.」

677:t_008:20.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Your words are incomprehensible. However, there is one certainty.」

677:t_008:21.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「It is that humanity has no need of emotions.」

677:t_009:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This world has no need of emotions.」

677:t_009:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then there would be no more sorrow or suffering...」

677:t_009:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...Got it. I'll settle this for good.」

677:t_009:9.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Let's show them... no, let's make them hear it, $$バサラ$$! Our feelings... our song, for those people!」

677:t_009:10.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I goooo!! Listen to my soooong!!」

677:t_010:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I can hear $$バサラ$$'s song...」

677:t_010:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Even if we fail, even if we feel like giving up, we take on the challenge...」

677:t_010:5.en:
$$レド$$
「That is what it means to be human.」

677:t_010:6.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Incomprehensible. I ask the meaning of this noise.」

677:t_010:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「One who cannot understand that will never be able to understand humans.」

677:t_010:9.en:
$$オズマ$$
「A thing like that calling itself a god... the ruler of humanity... don't make me laugh!」

677:t_010:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「Learn from Al and Chamber, and not only about humans, but the lines for moments like this too!」

677:t_010:13.en:
$$アル$$
「Then, $$チェインバー#robot$$. A word for the lady who's all head and no heart.」

677:t_010:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Drop dead, you tin can!」

677:t_011:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do it, $$チェインバー#robot$$! You, a machine, and me, a human, will combine our strength and stop it!」

677:t_011:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Humans are not tools. A human is one who seeks better ways to use tools for their own happiness.」

677:t_011:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$. This unit hopes that you will come to know what humans are through this battle.」

677:t_012:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! Our fight with you ends here!」

677:t_012:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Come on! Your feelings... we'll take them all!」

677:t_012:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Even that arrogance... feels pleasant to me now.」

677:t_012:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But I too have my stubbornness and pride! Let me make one last fruitless flower bloom on this planet!」

677:t_012:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units! Our targets are the original Striker and $$ミカゲ$$!」

677:t_012:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's do it! Break through them and hit the $$ギャラクシー船団$$!」

677:t_013:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「With Striker and $$ミカゲ$$ gone, nothing is left to stop us!」

677:t_013:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「All that's left is to hit the battleship fused with the $$バジュラ$$!」

677:t_013:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, regroup. We launch the assault!」

677:t_014:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We're detecting movement from $$バトル・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_014:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Damn...! It has completely fused with the Queen!」

677:t_014:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「A new swarm of $$バジュラ$$ and Ghost units are incoming!」

677:t_015:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「They still had that much strength left!」

677:t_015:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「If they gather all the $$バジュラ$$ deployed around this planet, it'll be several times that size!」

677:t_015:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I'm detecting strong fold waves from $$クイーン・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_015:3.en:
$$ルカ$$
「They're most likely combining that with control by the $$インプラント$$s to command the $$バジュラ$$!」

677:t_015:4.en:
$$カナリア$$
「And now the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ has obtained the power of the Vajra Queen.」

677:t_015:5.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The power of those fold waves must be beyond anything their artificial methods have managed until now.」

677:t_015:6.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「That's right. There is nothing more you can do.」

677:t_015:8.en:
$$カトル$$
「It's coming from $$バトル・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_015:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「A man... a woman...? What was that just now!?」

677:t_015:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Are multiple human voices overlapping!?」

677:t_015:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「It is not only the voices that overlap! The consciousnesses too!」

677:t_015:12.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「This is the truth of $$シンカ$$ that was inscribed in the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins...」

677:t_015:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Truth... $$シンカ$$...! Is that what Supreme Commander $$不動$$ was talking about!?」

677:t_015:14.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「To that end, we sought to gather our consciousnesses and create a single entity.」

677:t_015:15.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Yes, to become the same as the super-dimensional life form... the $$バジュラ$$, and advance life to the next stage.」

677:t_015:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「An attempt to make humanity one...」

677:t_015:17.en:
$$キリコ$$
「They're... the same as $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.」

677:t_015:18.en:
$$アルト$$
「They become the same as the $$バジュラ$$ and use their power!?」

677:t_015:19.en:
$$クレア$$
「They too are people possessed by $$シンカ$$...」

677:t_015:20.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Now, $$バジュラ$$! Our will is the Queen's will... you cannot refuse!」

677:t_015:21.en:
$$カイエン$$
「You're saying even $$バサラ$$'s song can't stand up to it!?」

677:t_015:23.en:
$$アンディ$$
「This is no time to be acting cool!」

677:t_015:24.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「That's right! Even your song might not get through to them!」

677:t_015:25.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I'm not the only one singing!」

677:t_015:26.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go, $$バジュラ$$! Listen to our song!!」

677:t_016:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's 'Lion' by the $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$!」

677:t_016:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
(I'll sing, $$アルト$$! For everyone, for myself, for the $$バジュラ$$!)

677:t_016:4.en:
$$シェリル$$
(The feelings that never reached you... But I have my song...)

677:t_016:5.en:
$$シェリル$$
(And now, I unleash them!)
